name: Structured knowledge
summary: Typed knowledge beside the notes: topics, entities, claims, decisions, contradictions, dead ends, the schema and the link graph.

features.name: Topics
features.summary: One page per theme with status, goal, milestones, decisions and open questions, kept by agents and the dream pass.
capabilities: Stores topics as append-only ULID-keyed records in the `topics` stream; fields resolve by authority, then time
Holds decision, open-question, log and milestone items; status active, waiting, blocked, on-hold, done, closed
Changes topic membership: assigns notes, signals and decisions, and merges or splits topics
CLI writes default to human authority (`topic record`: agent unless `--as-human`), `brain_topic` to agent
Renders topic.md; past 10 done milestones, 25 decisions or 15 log entries the oldest move to archive.md
Dream offers an unheld record active topics sharing 2+ and a fifth of its subject words; an answer picks one
Dream groups unheld records by rare shared words; 5 from 2 sessions become a topic after approval and wording
Review proposes merges of same-scope topics with head-word Jaccard >= 0.5 and asks about topics quiet 30 days
limits: Requires the brain store: a machine without one refuses every topic write
Automatic routing and grouping run only in the dream pass, on the dream owner's or the view writer's device
Merge, split and quiet-topic proposals are only listed; none is applied without a topic command
Below local reach (a remote MCP transport) only shared topics exist and human authority is refused

features.name: Entity registry
features.summary: Canonical people, projects and things with aliases, relations and subject profiles.
capabilities: Keeps one entity per category and normalized name in `Brain/entities/<category>/`, aliases checked first
Validates entity labels structurally against `entities.label_denylist` and a store-learned case lexicon
Matches person names by first initial plus surname, reversed word order and an operator nickname file
Relates entities with tokens of the relation vocabulary
Merges two entities under a plan hash: the old name becomes an alias, its page is archived, edges retargeted
Takes agent-extracted entities and relations, quarantined unless their source exists (`brain_intake_entities`)
Lists an entity's documents, a stated-versus-evidenced gap and a needs-llm-step envelope (`diarize`)
limits: brain_entity only reads; set, relate, archive, prune and merge run from the CLI
Runs no entity-recognition model: extraction comes from the calling agent through brain_intake_entities
A remote entity write that would land the entity in the private partition is refused

features.name: Claims and truth ledger
features.summary: An append-only truth ledger of entity claims with validity windows, and a claim graph read from memory front matter.
capabilities: Appends (entity, aspect, value, source) claims to device-sharded JSONL in `Brain/truth/`, folded into slots
Marks a slot contested when another source gives a different value within 30 days; resolution is ask_user
Accepts valid_from/valid_until windows; claims with disjoint windows count as succession, not as a conflict
Sums current quantity claims by exact (entity, unit) match, narrowed to an action only when asked
Reports an entity that 2+ agents claimed from 2+ distinct sources within 14 days
Commits agent-stated subject-relation-object claims only when both entities occur in the given assertion text
Splits text into atomic assertions, no model; --ingest --entity appends only quantity, email and URL facts
Answers truth now, at an instant, replaced-by and contested-by from Brain memory front matter (`brain claims`)
limits: Note capture writes no claims: truth ingest or state, facts --ingest, correction sweeps and hygiene apply do
`brain claims` reads only rule, signal and thesis front matter, not plain notes or the `Brain/truth/` ledger

features.name: Decision records
features.summary: Decision notes with options, assumptions, outcomes and ratings, open decisions, persona panels and design notes.
capabilities: Records a decision page in Brain/decisions/: chosen option, assumption, review date, pre-mortem, commitment
Opens one yearly review obligation per decision, anchored at its review date, idempotently
Finds similar past decisions and their outcomes by token overlap, with no model
Parks an open question with enumerated options until it is resolved into a decision page or discarded
Backfills the outcome of a decision and rates its quality from 1 to 5
Resurfaces at most one rated decision per prompt by token overlap, within a per-session cap and turn spacing
Panel runs one step per persona (default: technical, strategic, risk, user experience), then a synthesis
Design note grounds a topic in tensions, decisions and truth; commits it only with exactly one recommendation
limits: Runs no model: panel steps and design-note text come from the calling agent and are only validated
Rated-decision recall stays off until decision_recall.max_per_session is set
An older review obligation of a private decision keeps a shared copy that carries its title

features.name: Contradiction tracking
features.summary: Detects contradictions in the operator's notes and tracks each one from open to confirmed, dismissed or resolved.
capabilities: Detects contradictions among notes in notes.read_paths: prose token Jaccard >= 0.5 with opposite stance signs
Derives a note's stance from a built-in multilingual negation word list; no model takes part in detection
Saves each finding as Brain/tensions/tension-<slug>.md keyed by subject pair and stance; re-detection updates
Moves a tension from open to confirmed, dismissed or resolved, recording an optional operator reason
Warns at context-pack build when an injected memory is a subject of an open or confirmed tension
verify asks the optional tension decision model: contradicts, compatible or unrelated; never changes a tension
limits: Detection runs only on an explicit detect call; a vault with no notes.read_paths scans nothing
Single-glyph CJK negations are not detected by the whitespace tokenizer
verify answers available: false unless the tension decision-model use is configured

features.name: Failed approaches
features.summary: Records approaches tried and failed, with the reason; search and the session-start lessons digest surface them.
capabilities: Records one dead end (approach, why it failed, optional context) as a markdown page under Brain/dead-ends/
Names each page de-<date>-<slug> with an exclusive create; a same-day repeat gets a -2 suffix, never a loss
Keeps the newest 100 entries active (CLI --max-active) and moves the overflow to Brain/dead-ends/archive/
Lists active entries newest first; an unparseable or wrong-kind page comes back as a warning, not an error
Sanitises fields on write: approach one line of at most 256 chars, reason and context at most 1024 each
Feeds active dead ends into the lessons digest as Avoid lessons, 30-day half-life, within its 20-lesson cap
Leaves the pages to the regular search index, so recall can return a dead end beside notes
Below local reach, lists only readable dead ends and never archives a page the caller cannot read
limits: Matches nothing against a planned action; a dead end reaches an agent only via search or the lessons digest
Has no edit or remove operation; an entry leaves the active set only through the overflow archive

features.name: Schema packs and labels
features.summary: The record vocabulary of a brain: types, link types, labels and typed attributes, changed through audited mutations.
capabilities: Declares preference, signal and page types and log event kinds, with aliases, id prefixes and link types
Declares label dimensions with fixed values, allowed source->target type pairs per link, per-type fields
Applies a batch of 19 mutation kinds atomically under a file lock; the audit record holds the pack digest
Previews a batch with dry run: the resulting pack and a leaf-level diff, no config write, no audit record
Reports integrity ok, modified or unverified: sha256 of the rendered pack against the last audited apply
Reads the pack as stats, lint, graph, explain, orphans or the active pack
Assigns labels and typed attributes fail-closed, listing the declared values or fields in the refusal
Refuses undeclared capture kinds once `page_types` is set
limits: One active pack per brain: no pack registry, no pack by URL and no signature; the packs view lists one entry
brain schema sync is not implemented and exits non-zero
A deny in the permissions document reaches schema batches only through the ingest action, not on its own
Label suggestions need the optional labels decision-model use; without it suggest answers available: false

features.name: Link graph
features.summary: Backlinks, unlinked mentions, proposed bridge links, communities, hub coverage audits and a graph explorer.
capabilities: Lists inbound references to a rule or signal (`brain backlinks`)
Lists raw-text mentions of a rule's title or aliases that are not linked (`brain unlinked`)
Proposes bridge links between embedding-near notes with no shared edge, orphans first, cosine >= 0.8, top 10
Detects communities by deterministic label propagation (at most 20 sweeps); writes a note per community of 4+
Suggests edges between entities linked from the same notes by a PMI score (2+ shared notes, top 100)
Audits a hub rule's linked set as well-covered, fragile or missing; a hub needs 5+ links and 30% link text
Proposes missing edges by identity strength; `--apply` needs a confirm phrase, a holdout gate, max 25 writes
Rewrites wikilinks to full, short or preserved path forms (`brain links normalize`)
Refuses a remote bridge dismissal with the fixed answer while the dismissal list is private
limits: Backlinks read Brain rules, signals and logs; unlinked mentions, explorer and hubs cover rules; no plain notes
Bridge discovery needs the embedding index; without vectors it proposes nothing
Co-occurrence reads link structure only (wikilinks and typed relations), never note prose
The explorer serves on 127.0.0.1 only (default port 7777) or writes one exported HTML file

features.name: Synthesis and research reports
features.summary: Topic dossiers with agreements, contradictions and gaps, cited research reports, idea discovery and lineage.
capabilities: Builds a topic dossier over keyword recall (30 notes, max 100): agreements, conflicts, stale claims, gaps
Reads related/extends/supports links as agreement, contradicts as conflict, 90+ days or superseded as stale
Gives each finding a sha256 evidence identity, causal context and support, opposition and freshness scores
Names the single strongest objection to a dossier's findings
Writes a research report to Brain/reports/<date>-<slug>.md only when every finding cites a consulted source
Ranks next directions: open questions (weight 3), Brain/ orphans (2), inbox signals 14+ days old (1), plus age
Traces a continuity record or rule back to its observations through source refs or belief history, depth 8
Enqueues dossier contradictions and gaps, or the ranked ideas, into the trigger queue with --triggers
limits: Runs no model: prose synthesis, source fetching and finding text come from the calling agent
The research report is MCP-only; no CLI verb writes one
Deep synthesis recalls with the keyword lane only and refuses where no vault is attached
Orphan detection matches inbound links by bare basename, so two same-named notes can hide an orphan
